source.title: [Bounty #743] Validate /api/users payload before persistence
source.body:
## Problem

POST /api/users forwards req.body directly to createUser without schema validation. Any JSON object is accepted, including missing email/fullName, malformed email addresses, unhashed passwords, and prototype pollution fields. The in-memory user store then persists malformed user records, risking data corruption and unauthorized credential exposure.

## Requested fix

Add a strict Zod schema for user creation and validate the request in userController before persistence. Require a valid RFC-compliant email, require fullName between 2 and 100 characters, allow optional bio (up to 500 characters) and standard role ("client" or "freelancer"), exclude sensitive unhashed passwords from persistence, and reject malformed payloads with a 400 Bad Request error envelope. Add focused route/service tests for valid payload, invalid email, missing fullName, unknown property rejection, and password exclusion.

This issue is limited only to the creator of this issue. This means that only the issue author can attempt to solve this issue. If you would like to work on it, please create another issue with the same contents and refer to issue #743 for more information.

This issue is created under the Low Handing Fruit Automation bounty. I will submit a PR that references this issue and issue #743.

/bounty $700
